title: Skip the gate round, or say so in the brief, when the slice is already done and the round's implementer made no change

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-225521-b892, project ork, item S418:

Skip the gate round, or say so in the brief, when the slice is already done and the round's implementer made no change
